style.name: Modern Cottage
style.definition: Small-scale florals and painted wood meet the simplicity of Nordic furniture.
style.materials: painted sage timber; linen; oak; small floral cotton; woven rush
style.living: cream linen skirted sofa; muted rose small-floral armchair; oval oak coffee table; sage painted TV cabinet; compact oak table with four sage spindle chairs; pleated cream pendant
style.bed: sage painted spindle queen; white quilt with muted rose floral accents; oak nightstands; pleated ceramic lamps
style.solarium: sage powder-coated outdoor seating with cream performance pads; teak four-seat dining table
style.implement: Let one floral textile carry the cottage character; keep the furniture compact.
style.avoid: Avoid excessive ruffles and decorative shelves along the narrow passage.
